caption:
White-knuckling a temptation to stay strong? Some things you flee. (1 Timothy 6:11 devotional)

“Flee these things,” Paul says — not fight them. Some pulls only grow stronger the longer you stand and argue with them. Fleeing isn't cowardice; it's the courage to walk the way out God already opened.

📌 Save this for your quiet time this week
💬 Comment below — what's one thing you know you need to flee, not fight?
